chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about al-fuqqa', and he said: "It is khamr, and upon it is the hadd of the drinker of khamr."

key_terms.الْخَمْرِ: wine/intoxicant for which the hadd is established
key_terms.الْفُقَّاعِ: al-fuqqa'; an intoxicating beverage discussed in the legal ruling
key_terms.خَمْرٌ: khamr; an intoxicant legally treated as wine

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on al-fuqqa' in Shia hadith, and does it carry the hadd of khamr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on al-fuqqa', classifying it as khamr. It states that the legal punishment applied to one who drinks khamr also applies to it, showing its prohibition and legal seriousness in fiqh.
